# Third-party libraries served by MEIDNet Prism

Copied unchanged from the npm registry (tarball checksums verified against the registry), so that the documentation and
the Studio load no script from a content-delivery network.

| library | version | used for | licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| MathJax | 3.2.2 | equations in the documentation: `es5/tex-mml-chtml.js` and the parts it loads on demand (fonts, TeX extensions, menu, accessibility) | Apache-2.0 |
| tablesort | 5.3.0 | sortable leaderboard tables | MIT |
| chemiscope | 1.1.0 | the 3D explorer of the Studio | BSD-3-Clause |
